text:
rachel: Quick note — sablev2-int4 canary (streaming) showing a ~4.1% regression in funcall JSON parse success vs float. Symptoms look like a new 'double-EOF wobble' (duplicate closing tokens then cutoff).

priya: Example (sanitized):
```
{"action":"notify","data":{"user":"bob","msg":"done"}}}
...stream cut...
```

tom: Hmm. Duplicate brace then stream ends. Only on streaming, sync completes fine?

rachel: Yup sync ok. Chunk traces show PTQ variant emitting fewer final chunks on long tails. Last-chunk token counts down by 1-3 vs baseline.

priya: Could be token-ranking flips at low-margin logits for '}' or EOS. PTQ tends to reorder near-ties. Run token-align focusing on punctuation/EOS.

ci-bot: Running struct-sanity(500) + token-align --focus=punc --samples=800 for sablev2-int4 vs baseline. ETA ~90s.

tom: Short-term mitigations proposal: (A) canary-only "resume-probe" (send max_tokens=6 continuation when trailing pattern matches mid-JSON), (B) conservative "stitcher" postprocess that dedupes trailing punct and minimally closes structures, both must flag healed outputs and keep raw logs.

priya: Agree. Also add healed_by_type metrics: resume, stitch_close, strip_comma. And a golden-suite of 450 critical toolcall prompts to run across quant configs.

infra: Collected chunk histograms and last-token logits for 120 reproducer samples; uploaded to /canary/traces/sablev2-int4/3732109999.log

ci-bot: Results: sablev2-int4 parse_success=91.2%, resumed_success=2.9%, stitched_success=4.0%, final_failure=1.9%. baseline parse_success=95.7%, stitched_success=0.5%, final_failure=3.8%. Full report: /canary/reports/sablev2-int4/3732109999.json

rachel: Healing helps but raw parse gap ~4.5%. Next steps: (1) quick PTQ calibration sweep (per-channel, per-tensor, small clip) on same canary set; (2) kv-cache-off canary to see cache interaction; (3) run token-align diffs and p99 logits for truncated cases.

tom: Also run a small runtime patch: increase streaming buffer flush threshold on canary by +2 tokens to see if fewer premature flushes fix it. Make it toggleable for canary only.

priya: Release gate: hold rollout until raw parse_success >= 95% OR combined healed (parse + resumed + stitched) >= baseline_parse_success - 0.5% with healed outputs flagged and logged. Prefer raw fix via quant calibration or runtime chunk tweak.

rachel: I'll kick the calibration sweep and kv-cache-off canary, enable resume+stitch for canary, and wire healed metrics on the dashboard. Will post updates here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
